citations.proposition: Classify current/noncurrent assets and liabilities using rights at reporting date; IFRS 18 presentation is a separate 2027 transition event.
Financial-statement presentation follows actual period, framework, entity and substantive rights; material aggregation, comparative and offsetting conditions require explicit assessment.
Cash flows separate operating, investing and financing; noncash transactions do not enter cash totals, and indirect profit adjustments require a complete balance-sheet bridge.
Cashflows distinguish operating/investing/financing and noncash movements; indirect operating reconciliation uses correct asset/liability signs and excludes acquisition/FX effects.
Reconcile owner and non-owner changes in equity by component and disclose significant group/NCI interests according to applicable tier.
Equity component and NCI movements distinguish comprehensive income, owner transactions and retrospective adjustments; notes require transaction-specific populations and applicable-tier disclosure.
Material prior-period errors are corrected in comparative information, with opening-balance and disclosure consequences; checklist must reflect the applicable framework and period.

Comparatives preserve issued-to-restated bridge and framework-specific material error, policy transition and presentation consequences; checklist applicability follows actual entity and effective period.
Adjusting events provide evidence of conditions existing at reporting date; going-concern assessment through authorization can change the basis even when an event is otherwise non-adjusting.
Subsequent events confirming reportingdate conditions adjust measurement; newconditions ordinarily don't, but material disclosures and going-concern basis require independent evaluation.

IAS 10 adjusts events evidencing reporting-date conditions and does not adjust ordinary new conditions; management liquidation or no-realistic-alternative conclusion after reporting date precludes going-concern basis.
Related-party population depends on control/influence/KMP relationships; operating segments reflect CODM-reviewed components with reconciliation to entity amounts.
Related-party reporting derives from actual control/influence/KMP relationships; segments derive from CODM-reviewed components, scope, aggregation criteria and entity reconciliation.
Basic EPS divides profit attributable to ordinary shareholders by weighted-average ordinary shares; diluted EPS separately tests potential shares for dilution.
